verdict.rationale: Bulk triage applies to an email inbox provider like AgentMail, but the evidence never documents selecting many conversations at once or a bulk archive, label, or mark-done action. Labels can be attached to individual Messages and Threads (agentmail-docs-37), but that is a related per-item feature, not the multi-select one-stroke capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can select many conversations at once and archive, label, or mark them done in one stroke
